articles.title: President Trump declares 'energy ceasefire' between Russia and Ukraine
articles.snippet: "Ukraine supports the ceasefire, and it is important that Russia support it as well," said Ukrainian President Zelensky.

articles.title: DWF Labs subsidiaries sue BitGo for $141 million over alleged token lock-up breach
articles.snippet: DWF is seeking $114 million in damages on the basis BitGo’s token sales resulted in direct losses through the fall in tokens' prices.

articles.title: Thailand opens door to locally listed bitcoin and ether ETFs
articles.snippet: Thailand’s new crypto rules taking effect Oct. 16. They allow Thai asset managers to launch crypto ETFs on the local stock exchange, with bitcoin and ether initially eligible.

articles.title: Blockchain.com pursues CFTC approval for prediction markets: CNBC
articles.snippet: The crypto company has reportedly applied for two licenses with the US commodities regulatory as the courts weigh prediction markets cases.

articles.title: Tokenized Stocks Show Real Demand But Remain Volatile and Illiquid, IMF Finds
articles.snippet: An IMF analysis found that more than half of tokenized stock trading happens outside U.S. market hours, though the roughly $2.3 billion market remains more volatile and less liquid than traditional equities.
